page.layout: One page of text, single column; a decorative ornament band at the top; page number top right; a catchword-like word "mihi" at the lower right of the last line is part of the text line; signature mark "T 3" centred below the text block.

main_text.head: Nobilissimo & Amplissimo Viro, D. Johanni Dupanio Reipublicæ Genevensis Primario Exconsuli, S.
main_text.p: Quod perè ex ultima Thule prodiens, tot spatia marium & terrarum trajiciam ut ad lacum Lemanum pervenia-m, & Ego, qui sum homo privatæ sortis compellem Virum Principem, publicam stationem sustinentem, & primi ordinis inter Senatores Genevenses, tum florentem fortunâ & magna authoritate pollentem, ne sapientiam tuam, prudentiam & eruditionem in utroque jure, Divino & humano ponam inter illa fortunæ missilia: effecit fama tuæ humanitatis, & obviæ ac expositæ comitatis ex relatu, mihi

page.notes: The first word is a large woodcut-style initial "Q" joined to "uod"; rendered as "Quod". Several words are set in italic (Nobilissimo, Amplissimo, Viro, Johanni, Reipublicæ, Primario, Exconsuli, Quod partly). The head "Nobilissimo" is italic and spans several lines. The printed "T 3" at the foot is a signature mark, omitted from the text. Scan is slightly damaged at the right edge; the final word "mihi" is printed at line end and also appears where a catchword would sit, so it is kept in the text.
